roleContext.jobDescription: The card dispute handling service processes chargeback and dispute cases for the bank's cardholders under scheme deadlines. The Service Delivery Manager runs the live service: holds the production support rota, has handled production incidents that threatened scheme deadlines, coordinates production changes with the card operations and technology teams, tracks the service's deadline performance for the scheme reports, and documents the boundaries of the service after each incident and change. The role reports to the head of card operations and works with the dispute agents, technology and the scheme liaison team.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Service Delivery Manager, Card Dispute Handling

## Experience

- Ran the card dispute handling service in production for the bank's cardholder portfolio for three years, holding the production support rota and the deadline escalation procedure for the dispute agents.
- Handled the production incidents logged against the service in that period, including the two case-routing outages of the last year, with incident records filed in the operations incident register.
- Coordinated production changes with card operations and technology in the monthly change window, recording in the change log which checks were mine and which belonged to technology.
- Maintained the service runbook and the deadline performance report that fed the quarterly scheme reports, updating the runbook after each incident and each change.
- Wrote the post-incident notes and the change hand-over notes, listing the known limitations of the case-routing rules and the conditions handed to the next rota holder.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the service runbook, the deadline performance report for the last two quarters and the incident records for the two case-routing outages, with the operations incident register identifiers as a verification trail.
